The currencies in `rates.py` exactly match the six listed in the request (USD, EUR, GBP, SGD, JPY, INR). This is a straightforward, single-file edit.

```json
{
  "speech_act": "promise",
  "conditions_of_satisfaction": [
    "README.md contains a new 'Supported currencies' section",
    "The section lists all six currencies: USD, EUR, GBP, SGD, JPY, INR",
    "The listed currencies match exactly those defined in tally/rates.py",
    "No other content in README.md is modified"
  ],
  "scope_exclusions": [
    "Exchange rates or conversion details are not documented — only the supported currency codes",
    "No changes to source code or tests"
  ],
  "concern": ""
}
```
